About Ahmed Othman

Bridging Strategic Business Operations with Technical Execution

In today's competitive landscape, organizations frequently invest heavily in enterprise software and automation tools without achieving their intended return on investment. The disconnect is rarely the software itself—it is the gap between operational reality and technical implementation.

As an Independent Technology & Automation Consultant, I operate at this critical intersection. I analyze complex, cross-departmental business processes, isolate systemic bottlenecks, and engineer clean, scalable technology solutions that directly improve operational efficiency.

My consulting practice spans core enterprise resource planning with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, low-code application development through the Microsoft Power Platform, end-to-end robotic automation with UiPath, and emerging AI-driven intelligent business workflows.

Beyond system delivery, I place significant emphasis on technology adoption and corporate knowledge transfer. A technology implementation is only as valuable as the team's ability to operate, trust, and leverage it day-to-day.

Key Focus Areas

Enterprise Business Analysis Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O Power Automate & Power Apps RPA & Workflow Architecture Corporate Technology Literacy Applied AI Automation

Consulting Philosophy

1

Understand First, Automate Second

Automating a disorganized process merely magnifies inefficiencies. We streamline the underlying workflow before configuring any software.

2

Pragmatic Over Complex

The best technology solution is the one your organization can reliably maintain, scale, and trust without perpetual external dependencies.

3

Quantifiable Business Impact

Every proposed automation or ERP refinement must tie back to hours reclaimed, errors avoided, faster order-to-cash cycles, or executive clarity.

The Independent Advantage

Why Partner With an Independent Consultant?

Avoid large agency overhead, junior staff delegation, and bloated project scopes. Work directly with an experienced practitioner focused on your business objectives.

Business-First Approach

I don't recommend technology for its own sake. Every recommendation begins with your operational bottlenecks, cost structures, and ROI targets.

Direct Senior Accountability

You work directly with me from initial discovery to deployment and training—no delegation to junior associates or multi-layered account managers.

Practical, Scalable Delivery

We prioritize leveraging your existing enterprise subscriptions (Microsoft 365, D365, Power Platform) before recommending new paid tools.

End-to-End Capability

I carry solutions across the entire lifecycle: stakeholder interviews, BPMN process mapping, functional design, development, and UAT.

Knowledge Transfer & Adoption

I don't leave you with a black box. Your team receives structured training, comprehensive SOP documentation, and the tools to maintain workflows.

Agile & Cost-Effective

Zero agency overhead means faster project kickoffs, flexible milestone-based scoping, and significantly greater value per consulting dollar.
